post.description:
Run the multi-agent analysis pipeline and persist the result.

Runs synchronously — the MVP has no Celery worker (see plan Part B3).
The AI service is stateless, so the project state is read here and
handed over as a snapshot; the AgentRun row this creates is the only
persistent record of the run.

post.description:
Create a teammate's account inside this organization.

Registration always creates a new organization, so without this there is no
way to put a second person in an existing org — and therefore nobody to
assign tasks to. The creator supplies an initial password and shares it.
